title: Spain’s Pablo Hernández de Cos wins race to be next ECB president
summary_full: Former Bank of Spain governor chosen to succeed Christine Lagarde after winning support of EU’s biggest countriesSpain’s Pablo Hernández de Cos has been chosen as the next president of the European Central Bank, to succeed Christine Lagarde, after winning support from the EU’s biggest countries.The economist and monetary policymaker will become the first Spaniard to lead the ECB, defeating his rival candidate Klaas Knot, the former head of the Dutch central bank.
